observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow cooking gas cylinder with a top valve area and a handle/sitter-like frame; visible dents/scratches and wear.
Photo 1 shows a blue cooking gas cylinder with the top valve area; visible dents/scuffs and wear.
Photo 2 shows a blue cooking gas cylinder from above with the valve opening; visible wear around the top and body.
No clear readable brand/model, cylinder capacity marking, or certification stamp is legible in the provided photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show gas cylinders but no clearly readable capacity marking (12.5kg) or model/certification text that can be confirmed.
Photos show cylinders but do not clearly confirm what 'standard' means (e.g., local vs foreign, refillable type, valve spec).

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg (could be another size), which changes value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cylinder’s capacity marking/stamp (e.g., '12.5kg') and any serial/inspection label, taken straight-on and readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case match among the comparables (treat as not confirmed capacity; value closer to the lowest matching cylinder listings).

risks.risk: Cylinder condition may be worse than it looks (leaks, valve damage, or heavy dents). Photos only show surface wear.
risks.proof: A short video showing the valve area and a leak test result (soap-bubble test) or a test at a gas plant/technician.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-free / valve not confirmed (worst-case: treat as needing inspection).

risks.risk: Photos appear to show different colored cylinders (yellow and blue); seller may be mixing items or showing multiple cylinders.
risks.proof: Confirm it is the exact same cylinder being sold by sending one continuous video from top valve to base, showing the same cylinder throughout.
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain/possibly wrong item (worst-case: match to the cheapest comparable).

risks.risk: Foreign vs local cylinder type may affect acceptance/refill value.
risks.proof: Close-up of any markings indicating local/foreign type and valve specification; also photo of the cylinder base stamp.
risks.if_unproven: Price as least favorable type/unknown acceptance (worst-case: lowest comparable).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder capacity marking/stamp showing '12.5kg' (and any serial/inspection label).
Close-up of the valve and regulator connection area (readable markings if any).
A short video of the exact cylinder being sold (top to bottom) to confirm it’s the same unit as in the listing.
Evidence of leak-free status: soap-bubble test around the valve/regulator connection or a technician/gas plant test result.
response.reason: The photos show gas cylinders but do not provide readable capacity/type markings, and the listing’s '12.5kg' claim cannot be confirmed remotely. Without that, a worst-case price selection would be guesswork.
